'''Qartuums''' were a [[goat]]-like species that inhabited the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]].

==Biology and appearance==
A species of hoofed quadrupeds about the size of a [[goat]],<ref name="Chapter 7" /> Qartuums<ref name="Art of">[[The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian (Season One)|''The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season One]]</ref> had long patches of hair on several areas of their body, including their belly, spine, and throat. They also had large protruding eyes and a small horn on their forehead.<ref name="Chapter 7" />

==History==
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate}}</ref> [[Din Djarin]], [[Carasynthia Dune]], [[Kuiil]], [[Greef Karga]], and three other [[bounty hunter]]s passed a member of the species while travelling across Nevarro's [[lava fields]].<ref name="Chapter 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Again, you ask yourself, 'What would Phill Tippett design for something like this?' He is so great at doing 'ugly-cute.'|[[Christian Alzmann]]|<ref name="Art of" />}}
Qartuums appeared in "[[Chapter 7: The Reckoning]]," an episode of the [[The Mandalorian Season One|first season]] of [[Jon Favreau]]'s television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''. The episode was directed by [[Deborah Chow]] and aired on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Chapter 7" /> on [[December 18]], [[2019]].<ref name="Airdate">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|date=2019-09-24|format=[[Wikipedia:PDF|PDF]]|work=[[Wikipedia:Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International|Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]]|pages=[https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf#page=1 p. 1]|archivedate=20210623202717}}</ref> The creatures were later identified as Qartuums in an illustration by [[Phil Tippett]] in the [[2020]] reference book [[The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian (Season One)|''The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season One]].<ref name="Art of" />
